acquisition_method.evidence: experiment types: Bottom-up proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition

alkylation_reagent.evidence: Reduction and alkylation of  cysteines were carried out using dithiothreitol (DTT) and iodoacetamide (IAA).

cleavage_agent.evidence: Proteins were  extracted using chloroform/water/methanol extraction and pellets were dissolved in 100mM  TEAB containing endoproteinase Lys-C (Fujifilm-Wako).
Digestion was carried out overnight at room  temperature followed by the addition sequencing-grade trypsin (Promega) and further digesting for 6 hours  at 37°C.

fractionation_method.evidence: Pooled  peptides were fractionated using a high-pH spin column (Fisher Scientific) into 8 fractions.

mass_analyzer.evidence: inferred: orbitrap  Fusion Lumos mass spectrometer operating in FT positive-ion mode.
